title: cenchrus compressus
intro: Cenchrus compressus, commonly known as Desert Sandbur, is a type of perennial grass native to North America. This plant is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Cenchrus compressus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to soothe the respiratory tract and promote the removal of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
